hypothesis: The causal near-to-far ATM implied-vol term ratio (term_slope) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with the subsequent forward signed log-return of the same underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the EVAL-74 term floor.
extends: EVAL-74/100 (same term_slope signal path and sealed EVAL-74 term floor) + EVAL-81 (same forward signed log-return target); distinct cell: single-asset term_slope -> forward signed return mean

protocol.title: Options near-to-far ATM implied-vol term ratio (term_slope) -> forward own-asset signed log-return predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-74/100 (same term_slope signal path and sealed EVAL-74 term floor) + EVAL-81 (same forward signed log-return target); distinct cell: single-asset term_slope -> forward signed return mean
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-74/81/94/98/100/101; no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-to-far ATM IV term ratio (e74._term_bars term_slope), forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward signed log-return = sum(log(close_i/close_{i-1})) over the SAME underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k), transcribed verbatim from sealed EVAL-81
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(term_slope_z_k, signed_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher near/far ATM IV ratio -> more positive forward signed return)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
